# Divinely Faded

> Divinely Faded is a one-barber shop in Carlsbad, New Mexico, run by owner and barber Timothy "Tim" Murillo, cutting since 2023. Appointments only, booked on Booksy. Tagline: "Elevate Your Standard."

Last updated: 2026-10-25. Canonical site: https://divinely-faded-two.vercel.app/ (English) and https://divinely-faded-two.vercel.app/es/ (Spanish).

## Visit and book

- Address: 303 S Halagueno St, Carlsbad, NM 88220
- Phone: (575) 706-3095 (texting preferred)
- Booking (appointments only): https://booksy.com/en-us/1113769_divinely-faded-timothy-murillo_barber-shop_28967_carlsbad
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=303+S+Halagueno+St+Carlsbad+NM+88220
- Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=15257330546621568190
- Hours: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 09:00–12:00; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 12:30–17:00; Sat 08:00–14:00. Closed Wed and Sun.
- Holidays: Open on holidays at regular hours; $20 holiday fee on the holiday itself.
- Payment: Cash, Card, Zelle, Cash App

## Services (price, appointment length)

- Essential Haircut: $50, 40 min. Precision haircut tailored to your style and head shape, straight razor neck cleanup, finished style.
- Signature Cut: $65, 45 min. Precision haircut, beard trim or line-up, hot towel finish and straight razor detailing. The most popular service.
- Luxury Grooming Experience: $80, 50 min. Consultation, haircut, beard sculpt, wash and scalp massage, facial steam, dual hot towels, straight razor detailing, basic hair design, ear and nose waxing, styling and a luxury fragrance finish.
- Straight Razor Beard Shave: $40, 40 min. Traditional wet shave with hot towels, premium shaving cream and a soothing aftershave.
- Head & Beard Shave: $80, 1 hr. Precision head shave and beard shave with hot towels and a soothing aftershave balm.
- Express Facial: $30, 30 min. Facial massage, warm steam, deep cleanse, gentle exfoliation and hydrating moisturizer.
- Deluxe Facial: $40, 40 min. Facial massage, warm steam, gentle exfoliation, hydrating moisturizer, advanced skin treatments and an anti-aging serum.
- Braids: Varies, 2 hr. Personalized braiding styles.
- Color Transformation: $120, 4 hr. Professional coloring including bleaching and toning to reach the shade you want.
- Perm: $95, 90 min. Customized perm for volume, texture and movement.
- Add-ons: hair design $10, wash & scalp massage $10, luxury fragrance $5, eyebrows $5, nose / ear wax $10
